fixed.item: breakages.json (safety): the P1 gate's G7 substep cost (+0.07 ms attributed to safety.monitor, air, fire, chemicals, devices).
fixed.how: Cause found: not safety's code (HEAD vs ADOPT safety files differ by 0.007 ms) but the kernel's phase-1 read-view static-index builds: safety's ~18 indexes were each built in the first substep through a read view per entity (0.13 of safety's 0.27 ms/substep in the 40-substep bench). perf: Safety's systems, bench_systems loop (40 substeps x seeds 0-3, best of 5 per system) on one snapshot of the shared tree with safety's files at HEAD vs changed: 0.278 -> 0.120 ms per substep (-0.158 ms, more than the +0.07 share). Per system: fire 0.047 -> 0.017, detectors 0.035 -> 0.032, monitor 0.034 -> 0.008, air 0.028 -> 0.009, chemicals 0.025 -> 0.004, status 0.024 -> 0.017, glass 0.020 -> 0.007, devices 0.017 -> 0.006, pests 0.011 -> 0.001, water 0.009 -> 0.004, bio 0.008 -> 0.002, batteries 0.007 -> 0.001. Steady state (after one warm-up substep) 0.139 -> 0.108. Engine CPU time (process_time, seeds 0-3, best of 3, 3 interleaved rounds): 1 h wait 0.332 -> 0.316 s; reset about +10 ms (15 ms timer resolution; the early index build, cheaper than the in-substep build it replaces). The machine was at 100 % CPU from other agents, so whole-engine wall totals (4-26 ms/substep) are not comparable across runs; only same-snapshot A/B deltas are reported. Cause of safety's share: the kernel's read-view index builds (request).

requests.request: World._matching (house_sim/kernel/world.py) evaluates a declared-read predicate on the plain record only when nothing at all is journaled (`reads is not None and not (journal or quiet)`); inside a step every entity gets a _ReadView/_StartView even when its reads are declared and the entity itself is neither journaled nor quiet. Per entity: if reads are declared and ('entities', eid) not in journal and eid not in quiet, call predicate(record). That is where the phase-1 G7 regression comes from for every domain whose indexes are first built (or re-judged) inside a step: safety measured 0.13 of its 0.27 ms/substep in `python tools/bench_systems.py 40 0 1 2 3` (the same loop after one warm-up substep: 0.134); safety now builds its per-substep indexes at episode start (order -100), people does the same at order 0, but lazily built and re-judged indexes still pay the views. Repro: on generated house 1 (871 entities) w.static_index('x', common.PREBUILT['chemicals'], reads=...) costs 0.48 ms per build between steps and 0.92 ms after w.begin(); w.set_scalar('time_s', 1.0) (best of 5 x 20), although no entity is journaled.
Still open from phase 1: a capability registry (plugins.provides / capable) to replace module-name couplings (review M2).
